title: NotSoStableCoin
tagline: It is a very simple and not detailed at all contract for a "stable"coin. Nothing much to explain. I started this road by wanting to use 1inch API for prices and swaps, Push for notifications and deploy it on Scroll and I've achieved none.
description: It is a very simple and not detailed at all contract for a "stable"coin. Nothing much to explain. I started this road by wanting to use 1inch API for prices and swaps, Push for notifications and deploy it on Scroll and I've achieved none. So now it's just a contract that exists but isn't deployed. :(
how_its_made:
The project WOULD benefit from 1inch swap and price APIs and notifications for everytime a "stable"coin would be minted. It existing on scroll is a cool thing by itself anyways.

Also this is my first ever project that I've learnt insane amount of information from. Really happy with what came out and I'll probably start getting smol prizes just by going to the hackathons. Huge milestones has been hit with these two contracts. Insane stuff.
